answer_1.quote: The development of large language models (LLMs) has afforded tremendous advancements in natural language generation (NLG)... We focus on free-form generation datasets, and evaluate on QA datasets such as CoQA, TriviaQA, and Natural Questions.

answer_2.quote: We use the Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) ... we also report Area Under Accuracy-Rejection Curve (AUARC) as evaluation metrics.

answer_3.quote: Inspired by prior work, we use the agreement of both LLaMA2-70B and gpt-3.5-turbo-0125's evaluations as acc, i.e., we prompt the LLMs to judge whether a generated response is correct.

answer_4.quote: 20 out of the 720 samples hard to decide during our manual annotation process, usually due to incorrect reference answers or intrinsic ambiguity in the questions.
answer_4.guideline: manual annotation of generated answers to determine correctness
